PLAN "General Strength for Post-L4-L5 Herniation (12 Weeks) + Anti-Inflammatory Nutrition + Cardio + 1RM Test + Recovery"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general strength safely post-disc injury"
  GOAL secondary nutrition:
    name "Support recovery and reduce inflammation with nutrition"
  GOAL secondary cardio:
    name "Improve cardiovascular health safely"
  GOAL secondary testing:
    name "Safely test 1RM on selected lifts"
  GOAL secondary recovery:
    name "Optimize sleep and recovery for performance and healing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1-4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday cardio 30m "Cardio Steady State":
        main:
          cycling 30m rpe 6
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Body & Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday cardio 30m "Cardio Steady State":
        main:
          elliptical 30m rpe 6
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body & Core":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          superman 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      NUTRITION:
        focus: "Anti-inflammatory eating"
        guidelines:
          - "Base meals around vegetables, fruits, whole grains, legumes, nuts, and seeds."
          - "Include fatty fish (salmon, sardine, mackerel) 2-3x/week for omega-3s."
          - "Use olive oil as primary fat source; limit processed oils."
          - "Choose lean poultry, eggs, and plant proteins; limit red and processed meats."
          - "Include turmeric, ginger, garlic, and herbs regularly."
          - "Limit added sugars, refined grains, and ultra-processed foods."
          - "Stay hydrated: aim for 2-3L water daily."
          - "Moderate caffeine and avoid excessive alcohol."
          - "Aim for 7-10 servings of colorful vegetables and fruits daily."
          - "Add chia or flax seeds to breakfast or snacks."
          - "Choose whole grains (quinoa, brown rice, oats) over refined grains."
          - "Snack on nuts and seeds instead of processed snacks."
          - "Continue to limit added sugars and processed foods."
          - "Try to include a fermented food (yogurt, kefir, sauerkraut) daily."
          - "Aim for 25-35g fiber per day from whole foods."
          - "Plan meals to include a variety of colors and plant foods."
          - "Review and adjust hydration as needed."
      RECOVERY:
        focus: "Sleep and recovery"
        guidelines:
          - "Aim for 7-9 hours of sleep per night."
          - "Maintain a consistent sleep and wake schedule, even on weekends."
          - "Establish a relaxing pre-bed routine (dim lights, reading, stretching, or meditation)."
          - "Keep bedroom cool, dark, and quiet."
          - "Limit screen time for 60 minutes before bed."
          - "Avoid caffeine after 2pm and large meals within 2 hours of bedtime."
          - "If waking with stiffness, do gentle stretching or cat_cow in the morning."
          - "Take at least one full rest day per week."
          - "Monitor energy, mood, and soreness daily."
          - "If sleep is poor, try a warm shower or bath before bed."
          - "Use a supportive pillow and mattress for spinal alignment."
          - "If waking up sore, add gentle stretching or cat_cow after waking."
          - "If sleep is disrupted, try journaling or meditation before bed."

  PHASE "Phase 2: Progression" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5-8:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper Body Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday cardio 35m "Cardio Steady State":
        main:
          cycling 35m rpe 7
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower Body & Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 4x8 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday cardio 35m "Cardio Steady State":
        main:
          elliptical 35m rpe 7
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full Body & Core/Abs":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 4x8 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      NUTRITION:
        focus: "Anti-inflammatory eating"
        guidelines:
          - "Continue previous habits."
          - "Experiment with new anti-inflammatory recipes."
          - "Batch cook and prep healthy snacks for the week."
          - "Aim for 30+ unique plant foods per week."
          - "Assess energy and recovery; adjust portions if needed."
          - "Prioritize home-cooked meals over takeout."
          - "Review and adjust meal timing for energy."
          - "Reflect on progress and identify favorite anti-inflammatory meals."
          - "Maintain hydration and fiber intake."
      RECOVERY:
        focus: "Sleep and recovery"
        guidelines:
          - "Continue previous habits."
          - "If feeling run down, add a nap (20-30 min) or extra rest day."
          - "If sleep is poor, avoid screens and caffeine after 12pm."
          - "If feeling fatigued, add a 20-30 min nap or extra rest day."
          - "If sleep is disrupted, try journaling or meditation before bed."

  PHASE "Phase 3: Consolidation & 1RM Test" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9-11:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper Body Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday cardio 40m "Cardio Steady State":
        main:
          cycling 40m rpe 6
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower Body & Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 4x8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday cardio 40m "Cardio Steady State":
        main:
          elliptical 40m rpe 6
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full Body & Core/Abs":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      NUTRITION:
        focus: "Anti-inflammatory eating"
        guidelines:
          - "Continue previous habits."
          - "Review and reinforce anti-inflammatory staples."
          - "Monitor energy, sleep, and recovery."
          - "Plan for long-term sustainability of anti-inflammatory eating."
          - "Celebrate progress and consistency."
          - "Reflect on changes in energy, mood, and recovery."
          - "Maintain variety and color in meals."
      RECOVERY:
        focus: "Sleep and recovery"
        guidelines:
          - "Continue previous habits."
          - "Prioritize sleep and rest for recovery."
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper Body Push/Pull (1RM Prep)":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x3 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday cardio 40m "Cardio Steady State":
        main:
          cycling 40m rpe 6
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower Body & Core (1RM Prep)":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x3 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday cardio 40m "Cardio Steady State":
        main:
          elliptical 40m rpe 6
      DAY Friday testing 60m "1RM Test Day":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x1 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          leg_press 5x1 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x3 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          plank 2x45s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 2x30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
      NUTRITION:
        focus: "Anti-inflammatory eating"
        guidelines:
          - "Continue previous habits."
          - "Set goals for maintaining anti-inflammatory nutrition beyond the programme."
          - "Review and celebrate progress."
      RECOVERY:
        focus: "Sleep and recovery"
        guidelines:
          - "Prioritize 8-9 hours sleep before 1RM test day."
          - "Use relaxation techniques (breathing, meditation) if anxious."
          - "Take a full rest day before test if needed."
          - "Continue all previous recovery habits."
